semantic_fragments.content: Supplementary information for 15.5.1.2: Primary voltage is the most adverse value from 90% to 110% of RATED voltage. Loads on other windings between no load and their NORMAL USE load. Short-circuit applied at end of windings or at the first point that could be short circuited under SINGLE FAULT CONDITION.

Supplementary information for 15.5.1.3: Loads on other windings between no load and their NORMAL USE load. Time durations: IEC 60127-1 fuse: 30 min at current from Table 32. Non IEC 60127-1 fuse: 30 min at the current based on characteristics supplied by fuse manufacturer, specifically, 30 min clearing-time current. When no 30 min clearing-time current data available, test current from Table 32 used until THERMAL STABILITY achieved. Other types of protective devices: until THERMAL STABILITY achieved at a current just below minimum current operating the protective device in a). This portion concluded at specified time or when a second protective device opened.
Supplementary information for control knob gripping diameter: Gripping diameter (d) is the maximum width of a control knob regardless of its shape (e.g. control knob with pointer).
